roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI & Orchestration

bullets: Own Maestro’s product strategy, roadmap, and execution, from discovery through launch and adoption.
Rethink how business processes are orchestrated with agents, people, and automations to deliver measurable outcomes.
Expand Maestro’s AI-native capabilities, including how UiPath’s and third-party coding agents build, test, deploy, and operate processes.
Drive capabilities across UiPath product teams to deliver a cohesive experience with enterprise reliability, visibility, and control.
Work directly with customers and partners, prototype ideas, and iterate quickly based on feedback and production learnings.
